runner_comparison.difference: Only main adds inference_gap_seconds_override to manifest. Trade execution and classification are unchanged.

limits: Stage03b and cf0 native cohorts each have only 3 repetitions per role on one lamp and one fixed counterpart. Observed means do not establish statistical dominance, optimal policy, or a peer win rate.
Seven peers have one controlled-provider fixed-counterpart trial per role. These are exploratory references, not native historical provider reproduction or actual head-to-head outcomes.
The fixed counterpart uses lamp reserve100 and buyer budget120. Its negotiating behavior is fixed and exploitable; results do not establish performance against independent adaptive agents.

Stage03b source commit a7d2057 and baseline cf0ed87 differ in several components. This audit measures combined observed behavior, not causal contribution of RL, quote normalization, prompts, or stance.
Stage03b fixed cohort uses manifest gap override10; baseline frozen harness explicitly uses interval10. C2 gap5 results remain a separate cohort.

Native stderr headers prove reported gpt-6-sol/low identity, not independent provider-internal model execution. Controlled peer identity was previously verified through adapter/shared HTTP evidence in the linked prior independent audit; shared HTTP calls cannot be allocated per trade here.

Native stage03b requires 2 buyer calls each (1 quote observation plus 1 negotiation) and 5/5/6 seller calls, compared with baseline 1 buyer call and 3 seller calls per trade. Latency includes queue pacing, startup, networking and generation, so it is not pure inference latency.

Source hashes were independently rechecked against frozen participant paths. Manifest source commits identify submitted snapshots; this does not independently prove those commits equal a remote current HEAD.
Ongoing Stage03c and Stage4 work were not inspected or included.
